description: Has this site's CDN started refusing AI crawlers? Reads OpenAEO's corpus of per-crawler reachability observations to show what each crawler is served today, what changed since the last observation, and how often each has been blocked. Answers what robots.txt cannot: a CDN can refuse ClaudeBot while robots.txt allows it, and a provider changing a default is invisible to the site owner. Needs OPENAEO_API_KEY (Solo and above).

domain.description: Domain to look up, e.g. example.com
